methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from official vendor pricing pages where available. TechSmith (Camtasia, Snagit) and Movavi official pages returned EUR prices due to geo-IP routing; USD prices for Camtasia and Snagit sourced from GetApp and SoftwareAdvice aggregators (noted in provenance). Movavi excluded because no verified USD price could be found from any source. Vimeo annual-billing monthly rates corrected on verification to $12 (Starter) / $25 (Standard) / $75 (Advanced) per uscreen.tv and multiple aggregators; prior $13/$26/$76 figures were each $1 too high and were fixed. Camtasia Starter monthlyUsd set to null: Capterra describes a free watermarked tier but the official TechSmith page lists Starter as a paid ~EUR 39.57/year subscription, so the free claim could not be confirmed. Camtasia Pro ($499/yr), Snagit Individual ($39/yr) and Business ($48/yr), and Loom Business ($18 m2m / ~$15 annual) and Business+AI ($24 m2m / ~$20 annual) were independently confirmed and left unchanged. OBS Studio is free/open-source with no paid tiers. All prices are recurring monthly costs expressed as the annualized monthly rate where annual-only billing applies. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.
